The Cavaliers defeated the Wizards, 121-111 tonight in Cleveland. Evan Mobley finished with a team-high 24 points along with 12 rebounds and 5 three pointers for the Cavaliers, while Peyton Watson tallied 22 points, 6 rebounds and 2 assists in the game. AJ Dybantsa recorded 19 points, 2 rebounds and 2 assists. The Cavaliers improve their record to 3-1 with the win, while the Wizards fall to 2-3 for the season.
